notes.title: Deploy new game
notes.content: This game replace Frontier Force Vanguard with new game 4th Horizon

notes.title: Redevelop the Game from Scratch
notes.content: [p]Due to a shortage of funds, I’ve had to make major changes to this game’s development. Instead of hiring a sprite artist, I’ll be creating my own assets for the time being. However, if I continue using my own drawing style, the visuals may end up inconsistent. Because of this, I’ve decided to take a different approach and redevelop the game with a new concept.[/p][p]From this point on, [b]The 4th Horizon[/b] will replace [b]Frontier Vanguard[/b]. The game will now be a turn-based tactical RPG. I previously uploaded a screenshot and a playable sample on itch.io, but I’ve disabled it for now out of concern that it might conflict with Steam’s agreement.[/p][p]For those who have already purchased the game, if you would like a refund due to these significant changes, I’m more than willing to support it if Steam reaches out to me for approval. Cheers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544579/4ee8493f4708219e935e4630800c7cdb3c09ba29.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544579/4c092242105693844ba25d4dc5823d4313765f2b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Development Plans and Changes
notes.content: As of the current state of the game, it feels clunky and needs major changes. The world map view will also require a significant update, as well as the research tree. Due to some issues I’m currently facing, development is delayed for another 2–3 weeks until I can return and review the game again. Cheers.

notes.title: Updating game flow and system
notes.content:
Previously, a completed area could be replayed. Now, it has been replaced with a variant where players can explore new areas, such as dungeons. Expanded areas like dungeons require a key to unlock and explore. Players cannot build anything in dungeons, as they are purely for exploration. In the future, dungeons will be required as part of the story to find or gather resources, or to fulfill demands from factions in order to earn their commendations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544579/cdc2e1c512592fbdea99a3d04fb45e98e7aa1ab1.png[/img]

Other updates include adding minimal information on unit statistics to make it easier for players to compare them with enemies. However, enemy information has not been implemented yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544579/87ba5f9e8ff5b873e5e0288f7bcc210dcc75562f.png[/img]

Various bug fixes have also been applied, such as fixing an error when upgrading Catapult damage and improving enemy pathfinding. However, it still needs significant improvement in the future. 

The next update will focus on expanding the explorable areas on the map, while also adding new enemies and dungeons for quests.

notes.title: Early Access Build
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Multiple bug fixes and damage calculation adjustments.
 
[*] Added a new ARMOR parameter for damage calculation (not yet implemented).

[*] ARMOR reduces damage after resistance is applied. Any damage below 0 will be registered as 0.1 instead.
 
[*] Disabled fade-in/out effect due to a bug.
 
[*] Added a treasure box to support the player.
 
[*] Added a dungeon placeholder.
 
[*] Dungeons allow players to send their troops to investigate, where various events can occur.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Fix, Patches and Control Improvement
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix attribute of units and building and damage calculation
[*] related to research tree, update research tree, add new unit "SCOUT". Scout can reveal area
[*] Fix glitchy enemy behavior, now it can attack with skill correctly and able to cast self spell
[*] Add enemy skills, enemy strike based on skill assigned to them

[/list]
